Campus.title: Campus
Campus.description: Represents a university campus within the GAM Hub platform, serving as a partition for multi-tenant data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Campus entity.

name.description: The official name of the university campus (e.g., 'Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology').

domain.description: The email domain associated with this campus (e.g., 'knust.edu.gh'), used for user authentication validation.

location.description: Geographic location of the university campus.

logoUrl.description: URL to the campus logo or emblem.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the campus record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the campus record was last updated.

radioName.description: The name of the campus radio station.

radioStreamUrl.description: The digital streaming URL for the campus radio station.

radioWebsite.description: The official website of the campus radio station.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user account within the GAM Hub platform, associated with a specific university campus and role.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

email.description: The user's email address, used for login and campus affiliation. (Relationship: User 1:1 Authentication)

campusId.description: Reference to the Campus this user is associated with. (Relationship: Campus 1:N User)

role.description: The assigned role of the user (e.g., 'student', 'staff', 'vendor', 'admin') for access control.

isVendorVerified.description: Flag indicating if a vendor user has been manually approved by an Admin.

profileImageUrl.description: URL to the user's profile picture.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product listed for sale by a vendor on the E-Market platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Product entity.

campusId.description: Reference to the Campus where this product is available. (Relationship: Campus 1:N Product)

vendorId.description: Reference to the User who is selling this product (must have 'vendor' role). (Relationship: User 1:N Product)

description.description: A detailed description of the product.

price.description: The selling price of the product.

imageUrls.description: An array of URLs for product images.

category.description: The category the product belongs to (e.g., 'Electronics', 'Books', 'Services').

stockQuantity.description: The number of units of the product currently in stock.

isAvailable.description: Flag indicating if the product is currently available for purchase.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the product was listed.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the product details were last updated.

SocialFeedPost.title: SocialFeedPost
SocialFeedPost.description: Represents a user-generated post in the social feed for networking within a campus community.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SocialFeedPost entity.

campusId.description: Reference to the Campus where this social post is visible. (Relationship: Campus 1:N SocialFeedPost)

authorId.description: Reference to the User who created this post. (Relationship: User 1:N SocialFeedPost)

contentType.description: The type of content in the post (e.g., 'text', 'youtube', 'tiktok', 'image').

content.description: The main content of the post (e.g., text, YouTube/TikTok link, image URL).

description.description: An optional caption or additional description for the content.

likesCount.description: The number of likes received by the post.

commentsCount.description: The number of comments on the post.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the social feed post was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the social feed post was last updated.

isModerated.description: Flag indicating if the post has been reviewed by a moderator.

SrcPost.title: SrcPost
SrcPost.description: Represents an official announcement or informational post from the Student Representative Council (SRC) for a specific university campus.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SrcPost entity.

campusId.description: Reference to the Campus this SRC post belongs to. (Relationship: Campus 1:N SrcPost)

authorId.description: Reference to the User (typically staff or student representative) who published this SRC post. (Relationship: User 1:N SrcPost)

title.description: The headline or title of the SRC post.

content.description: The full text content of the SRC post.

mediaUrls.description: An array of URLs for images or videos associated with the SRC post.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the SRC post was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the SRC post was last updated.

RegistryPost.title: RegistryPost
RegistryPost.description: Represents official, critical announcements or directives from the university's central administration or registry.

id.description: Unique identifier for the RegistryPost entity.

campusId.description: Reference to the Campus this registry announcement pertains to. (Relationship: Campus 1:N RegistryPost)

authorId.description: Reference to the User (typically staff or admin) who published this registry announcement. (Relationship: User 1:N RegistryPost)

title.description: The headline or title of the registry announcement.

content.description: The full text content of the registry announcement.

isUrgent.description: Flag indicating if this announcement requires urgent attention and should be prominently displayed.

expirationDate.description: Optional date and time when the announcement is no longer considered active or relevant.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the registry announcement was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the registry announcement was last updated.

definition.description: Top-level collection for university campus definitions. Accessible to all users for read to determine campus affiliation and details. Written by global administrators.

Stores user profiles, including their assigned `campusId` and `role` (student, staff, vendor, admin) for database-backed access control. Private read/write for the owner, admin read/write. Includes `isVendorVerified` for vendor approval status.

params.name: userId
params.description: Unique identifier for the user, matching `request.auth.uid`.

definition.description: Dedicated collection for identifying global administrators. The mere existence of a document at `/roles_admin/{userId}` grants global administrative privileges, aligning with the 'existence over content' DBAC principle. This document can be minimal, containing just the user ID, or a reference.

params.name: adminId
params.description: Unique identifier of the user who is a global administrator.

definition.description: Top-level collection for e-market products listed by vendors. Each product document includes denormalized `campusId` and `vendorId` for authorization independence. Vendors can manage their own products, and campus members can view products from their campus.

Top-level collection for user-generated social feed posts. Each post includes denormalized `campusId` and `authorId` for authorization independence. Users can create, update, and delete their own posts, and all campus members can read posts from their campus.

params.name: socialFeedPostId
params.description: Unique identifier for the social feed post.

definition.description: Top-level collection for official Student Representative Council (SRC) announcements. Each post includes denormalized `campusId` and `authorId` for authorization independence and QAPs. Accessible to all campus members for reading. Written by authorized SRC members.

params.name: srcPostId
params.description: Unique identifier for the SRC post.

definition.description: Top-level collection for official university registry announcements. Each post includes denormalized `campusId` and `authorId` for authorization independence and QAPs. Contains `isUrgent` flag for specific filtering requirements. Accessible to all campus members for reading. Written by authorized staff/administrators.

params.name: registryPostId
params.description: Unique identifier for the registry announcement.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure for GAM Hub is designed with a strong emphasis on security, scalability, and debuggability, adhering strictly to the provided core design principles and strategy mandates. The core of the design revolves around a multi-tenant architecture where data is partitioned by `campusId`.

**Authorization Independence & Denormalization:**
To achieve critical Authorization Independence, all documents that require `campusId`, `authorId`, or `vendorId` for access control (e.g., `Product`, `SocialFeedPost`, `SrcPost`, `RegistryPost`) store these fields directly within their own document. This means a security rule inspecting a `Product` document does not need to perform a `get()` operation on a parent `Campus` or `User` document to determine access rights. For example, a rule for a product can check `resource.data.campusId` and `resource.data.vendorId` directly. This eliminates hierarchical authorization dependencies, making rules atomic, simpler, and less prone to breaking during batched writes or transactions. While the user's initial request mentioned 'custom claims for roles', this design explicitly follows the 'DBAC (No Custom Claims)' mandate. Therefore, user roles and `campusId` for the requesting user are stored in their respective `users/{userId}` document. For `list` operations, this means security rules will perform a `get()` on the current user's document (`/users/$(request.auth.uid)`) to retrieve their `campusId` and `role` to validate query filters, rather than relying on `request.auth.token` custom claims.

**QAPs (Queries as Authorization Primitives):**
QAPs are enabled through Structural Segregation and the denormalization of authorization context. Each distinct type of post (`SocialFeedPost`, `SrcPost`, `RegistryPost`) and `Product` is housed in its own top-level collection (`/social_feed_posts`, `/src_posts`, `/registry_posts`, `/products`). This segregation ensures that all documents within a collection share a homogeneous security posture, simplifying rule sets. For instance, all documents in `/src_posts` are official SRC announcements, accessible to all members of the specified `campusId` for reading, and only to authorized SRC members for writing. Because `campusId` is denormalized into every document, client-side queries can efficiently filter data by `campusId` (e.g., `db.collection('src_posts').where('campusId', '==', userCampusId)`). Security rules then validate that the `campusId` requested in the query matches the `campusId` associated with the authenticated user (retrieved from `get(/users/$(request.auth.uid)).data.campusId`). This prevents clients from requesting data outside their permitted campus and ensures that rules are not used as filters after data retrieval, thus maintaining QAPs.

**Role-Based Access Control (DBAC):**
Roles are managed within the `users/{userId}` document via the `role` field. For global 'admin' privileges, an 'existence over content' pattern is used with a dedicated `/roles_admin/{adminId}` collection. The presence of a document in this collection for a `userId` grants admin status, allowing for efficient and explicit rule checks without relying on custom claims, aligning with the DBAC mandate.
